steps.page_title: AI Regulation: What the New EU Framework Means for Tech Companies — The New York Herald

actions.text: The EU's new AI framework is a necessary step toward safer, more transparent AI — but its success will hinge on practical implementation. Large firms can absorb compliance costs, yet startups and SMEs risk being sidelined unless regulators provide clear, interoperable standards and scaled support. Policymakers should prioritize measurable transparency requirements, investment in compliance tooling, and international coordination to avoid fragmentation. Done right, the framework can protect citizens without stifling innovation; done poorly, it will entrench incumbents and slow valuable research.
